verdict.rationale: vLLM is an inference/serving engine. A product of this kind could plausibly expose an assistants-style configuration layer, so the axis applies, but the evidence documents no feature for creating or saving task-specific custom assistants. Multi-LoRA adapters, tool calling, structured outputs and the OpenAI-compatible API are developer building blocks a user could assemble into such assistants, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.
